text: The package `c4s-plugin-app-spec` (project-plugin root, sections 5xmrx4j7 and 9yf6vj9w) is not in the implementation repo: it is the project-local overlay of the `app-spec` project and lives in the specification repository at `.claude4spec/plugins/c4s-plugin-app-spec` (claude4spec-private/app-spec), outside the repo this build may edit. Its `src/manifest.ts` doc comment still reads "`skills`, `subagents`, `writingStyles`, `settings` and `commands` stay empty until the project needs them" — i.e. it still names the removed `settings` slot among the unoccupied ones. Assumed: this build changes only the in-repo package (`plugins/c4s-plugin-database-tables`); the app-spec overlay's comment is to be updated by its owner in the spec repository (drop `settings` from that list). Its manifest declares only `contributes.entities`, so nothing functional depends on it, and the host (u2) no longer reads a `settings` key.
